scope: Read-only native/backend/marketing source and public pages. Only research artifact changed. No secrets, environment values, IP addresses, customer records, live backend queries, builds, simulator, deployments, ASC mutations or legal declarations.

verification.code: Current working-tree source, not released/runtime certification.
verification.public: Current public privacy label and policy fetched.
verification.authenticatedASC: Existing snapshot contains versions/appInfos/policy URLs, not App Privacy questionnaire; public label is the observed privacy statement.
verification.sdk: Official Google disclosure describes potential SDK collection, not app-specific traffic capture.

dataFlows.storageOrTransmission: Provider credential transmitted for verification; S3 identity/email/account/token indexes and local protected session file.
dataFlows.uncertainty: No persistent provider credential storage established in this server path; own session differs from provider sync credentials. Deployed version unknown.

dataFlows.storageOrTransmission: Shared-event PUTs and calendar event batches to own backend; persistent canonical S3 records and generated feeds.
dataFlows.uncertainty: Supported fields need not be populated on every event. Does not establish that all private calendars upload. Exact access of public links and provider field availability not runtime tested.

dataFlows.storageOrTransmission: Recipient/account indexes and share metadata persist server-side.
dataFlows.uncertainty: No broad end-to-end encryption or anonymous-data claim is established.

dataFlows.storageOrTransmission: Amazon SES payloads; source logs recipient and subject on success, skip and failure.
dataFlows.uncertainty: Production SES configuration and logs/retention not inspected; no live mail or customer records read.

dataFlows.storageOrTransmission: S3 registrations and receipts; conditional SQS jobs; APNs payload.
dataFlows.uncertainty: Conditional on backend configuration. Sandbox default; production NOT asserted. Skipping jobs older than24h is not a general retention/deletion policy.

dataFlows.purpose: Connect and edit provider calendars and meetings
dataFlows.storageOrTransmission: Provider APIs; local account model JSON saved to UserDefaults; SDK caches not exhaustively audited.
dataFlows.uncertainty: Do not claim all tokens are Keychain-only. No actual token values read. Full API payload matrix/runtime behavior not audited.

dataFlows.storageOrTransmission: Google People API responses; iOS Contacts writes after Contacts permission.
dataFlows.uncertainty: Conditional on permissions. No evidence here of wholesale contact book upload to own server; recipient addresses are a separate flow. iOS Contacts backing account depends on device.

dataFlows.storageOrTransmission: Private JSON snapshot; app-group UserDefaults for widget snapshot.
dataFlows.uncertainty: Unshared local data distinct from server shares. Device backups/storage lifecycle not exhaustively audited.

dataFlows.storageOrTransmission: Apple WeatherKit coordinate request; local diagnostic print includes location.
dataFlows.uncertainty: GPS not only route; manual places supported. Retention/provider logs/identity linkage not verified; no sample coordinates retained.

dataFlows.storageOrTransmission: Google Mobile Ads request path gated by UMP; possible categories from official SDK documentation, not observed traffic.
dataFlows.uncertainty: No claim of personalized advertising, IDFA availability, ATT state, specific mediation partners or exact packet fields. Configuration review required.
No evidence of app receiving card details; not an exhaustive purchase/backend review.

dataFlows.storageOrTransmission: Browser fetch to Open-Meteo geocoding/forecast, separate from native WeatherKit.
dataFlows.uncertainty: Website hosting/CDN logs/cookies/analytics not fully audited; do not conflate providers.

exactAssertions: The developer does not collect any data from this app.
policyIssues.assessment: Material discrepancy for owner review against inspected identity/shared-content persistence and ad request paths. Not an Apple-questionnaire or legal conclusion; code/release/deployment correspondence unverified.

policyIssues.exactAssertion: Calendar event data accessed through these services remains under the control of those services and is processed within the App only as needed to display and manage your schedule.
policyIssues.assessment: Contradicted as blanket confinement to app processing when provider event/calendar content is shared to own backend. Additional server copy must be explained.

policyIssues.exactAssertion: though calendar data is primarily processed on-device or via direct API calls
policyIssues.assessment: Not quantitatively falsifiable from code; incomplete about persistent own-server sharing, SES and conditional push. Do not claim to know where most processing occurs.

policyIssues.exactAssertion: The integrated weather features require access to your location (approximate or precise, depending on your settings) to provide relevant forecasts.
policyIssues.assessment: Overbroad if read as mandatory GPS access: requests accept searched/saved coordinates too. Explain location choice.

policyIssues.exactAssertion: not stored by Cloud Calendars long-term associated with your identity
policyIssues.assessment: Unverified rather than declared false: no documented retention confirmed. Separate shared-event structured coordinates from weather-request coordinates.

Does not identify AdMob/UMP, contacts import, shared attachments/attendees, invitation email/logs or conditional push data. General possible analytics wording is insufficiently specific to these known flows.
Signout is not server erasure; final identity retained for recovery. Shared-calendar removal preserves tombstone snapshot. Retention schedule and full-account deletion process require confirmation.

exactAssertions: We do not sell your personal information.
These providers are bound by confidentiality obligations.
policyIssues.assessment: Neither verified nor disproved by code; requires owner/vendor-contract review.

evidence.finding: Sends provider token/provider/optional name/timezone to own resolve endpoint.
Persists provider/hashed-subject/email/account indexes; final recovery identity cannot be unlinked.
Backend S3 JSON records, calendar feeds and delete helper; no retention schedule established.
Own sharing session stored in Application Support with iOS file protection, not Keychain.
Signout clears local session and disables invitation push; server recovery account deliberately retained.

Sharing model supports attendee/organizer names/emails/status, notes, times, recurrence, alarms, structured location, video URL, travel time and attachment filename/type/base64 content; shared calendar metadata and event batches uploaded.
Canonical shared event includes title/start/end/all-day/location/URL/details/notes/organizer.
Removal of shared calendar preserves snapshot with deletedAt tombstone.
SES recipient/subject/HTML/text/reply-to/optional attachments; logs recipient and subject on success/skip/failure.
S3 installation/account/APNs-token records and receipts; configured SQS/APNs dispatch sends invitation sender/title. Default environment sandbox; production configuration unverified.
Google calendar/contact scopes, Microsoft calendar/profile scopes; provider account models include tokens/email/IDs/expiry/avatar; JSON models saved in UserDefaults.
Google People API names/email/phone requests; after Contacts permission creates/updates device contacts. Post-signin call at261.
Local calendar/event snapshot persisted as JSON.
Event title/location/times snapshot encoded in app-group UserDefaults.
Apple WeatherKit request using coordinates; print includes coordinates; distinguishes GPS and searched/saved locations.
When-in-use location permission; coordinates also printed diagnostically.
Google Mobile Ads Request load after consent gate.
Google UMP consent update/form/privacy options.
StoreKit purchase, transaction and entitlement APIs.
Website separately sends city search and forecast coordinates to Open-Meteo.
Policy template matched public text, date May 5 2025.
Snapshot top-level versions/appInfos; privacy policy URL records, not authoritative App Privacy questionnaire.
